Package neqsim.process.safety.release

Class ComponentSelectiveFiniteRateReleaseModel

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.safety.release.ComponentSelectiveFiniteRateReleaseModel
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, ReleaseFlowModel
public final class ComponentSelectiveFiniteRateReleaseModel extends Object implements ReleaseFlowModel
Component-selective first-order gas/liquid phase-transfer sensitivity with bounded drift flux.

Each overall component mass is partitioned independently between gas and liquid. Caller-declared relaxation times move the upstream gas-held mass of each component toward its equilibrium-station value over one declared residence time. The phase compositions reconstructed from those component inventories are explicit and mass conservative. The resulting one-gas/one-liquid state uses the shared Zuber-Findlay/Harmathy hydrodynamic closure.

This model does not predict transfer coefficients, residence time, heat transfer, droplet area or entrainment. It is a parameterized sensitivity model and remains unqualified.

1.0

    • ComponentSelectiveFiniteRateReleaseModel

      public ComponentSelectiveFiniteRateReleaseModel(double surfaceTensionNm, Map<String,Double> componentRelaxationTimesS, double residenceTimeS, String parameterProvenance)
      Creates a component-selective finite-rate sensitivity model.
      Parameters:
      surfaceTensionNm - caller-declared gas/liquid interfacial tension in N/m
      componentRelaxationTimesS - positive first-order relaxation time in s for every fluid component
      residenceTimeS - caller-declared available transfer time in s
      parameterProvenance - nonempty source or calibration identity for every supplied parameter
